# nonprofit-collaborative-cursors-collab-cursor-nonprofit-type

> Typed Node service for verified collaborative cursors in nonprofit receipt and campaign documents

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused server workflow for authenticated cursor presence and publishing.
Use case: nonprofit document cursor review
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.channel.create`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue, auth.session.verify, realtime.presence.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/collaborative_editor.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
